# Meta Model API (generated by `mme init` from MME's provider catalog; `mme models` prints the live table)

- Base URL `https://api.meta.ai/v1`, bearer auth, key in `MODEL_API_KEY`.
- Protocols: Responses `POST /v1/responses` (Meta's default; keeps reasoning across turns), Chat Completions
  `POST /v1/chat/completions` (OpenAI SDK; loses reasoning across turns), Messages `POST /v1/messages` (Anthropic SDK; host `https://api.meta.ai`).
- Images `/v1/images/generations` and `/v1/images/edits` (`muse-image-1.0`); transcription `POST /v1/asr/transcribe`
  (`muse-voice-transcribe-1.0`); SAM 3.1 via `/v1/files` + `/v1/responses` (`sam-3.1`).
- Prompt caching is automatic prefix caching: stable system prompt + schema + examples FIRST, variable input LAST.
  Optional `prompt_cache_key`; read `usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens`.
- Contributor models are ~12x cheaper but Meta may train on the data, and they're only offered in some countries. Use `MME_PRIVATE=1` to avoid them.
- 404 "Model not found" = wrong ID or a trailing slash in the base URL. Back off on 429.

# How to call
```python
from mme.client import client
data = client().chat_json(messages, json_schema=Model.model_json_schema(), tier="draft",
                          tag="brief->program", prompt_cache_key="brief-v1")
```
Tiers: draft (iteration, tests) · standard (evals, demo recordings) · max (only when standard measurably fails).
Never import a provider SDK in product code.
